title: Impact of Hospital Proximity on Mortality Rates

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
I will use Instrumental Variables (IV) estimation with distance to nearest hospital (z) as an instrument for care intensity (x). The key assumptions are: (1) Relevance: distance to hospital affects care intensity, (2) Exclusion restriction: distance to hospital only affects mortality through its effect on care intensity, and (3) Exogeneity: distance to hospital is uncorrelated with unobserved factors affecting mortality. This leverages geographic variation to identify causal effects of care intensity on mortality.

## 2. R Code
```r
# Load required libraries
library(AER)
library(stargazer)

# Read the data
data <- read.csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s67_data.csv")

# Display summary statistics
cat("Summary Statistics:\n")
print(summary(data))

# Check first-stage relationship (relevance condition)
cat("\n=== FIRST STAGE: Effect of Distance on Care Intensity ===\n")
first_stage <- lm(x ~ z + controls, data = data)
print(summary(first_stage))

# Extract first-stage F-statistic
first_stage_f <- summary(first_stage)$fstatistic[1]
cat("\nFirst-stage F-statistic:", round(first_stage_f, 2), "\n")

# OLS estimation (for comparison)
cat("\n=== OLS ESTIMATION (potentially biased) ===\n")
ols_model <- lm(y ~ x + controls, data = data)
ols_coeff <- coef(ols_model)["x"]
cat("OLS coefficient on care intensity:", round(ols_coeff, 4), "\n")

# IV estimation using 2SLS
cat("\n=== IV ESTIMATION (2SLS) ===\n")
iv_model <- ivreg(y ~ x + controls | z + controls, data = data)
iv_summary <- summary(iv_model)
print(iv_summary)

# Extract key results
iv_coeff <- coef(iv_model)["x"]
iv_se <- iv_summary$coefficients["x", "Std. Error"]
iv_pvalue <- iv_summary$coefficients["x", "Pr(>|t|)"]

cat("\n=== KEY RESULTS ===\n")
cat("IV coefficient on care intensity:", round(iv_coeff, 4), "\n")
cat("Standard error:", round(iv_se, 4), "\n")
cat("P-value:", round(iv_pvalue, 4), "\n")
cat("95% CI: [", round(iv_coeff - 1.96*iv_se, 4), ",", round(iv_coeff + 1.96*iv_se, 4), "]\n")

# Robustness checks
cat("\n=== ROBUSTNESS CHECKS ===\n")

# 1. Weak instrument test
cat("1. Weak Instrument Test:\n")
cat("First-stage F-statistic:", round(first_stage_f, 2), "\n")
if(first_stage_f > 10) {
  cat("Strong instrument (F > 10)\n")
} else {
  cat("Weak instrument concern (F < 10)\n")
}

# 2. Reduced form (effect of instrument on outcome)
cat("\n2. Reduced Form Estimation:\n")
reduced_form <- lm(y ~ z + controls, data = data)
rf_coeff <- coef(reduced_form)["z"]
cat("Reduced form coefficient:", round(rf_coeff, 4), "\n")

# 3. Compare OLS vs IV
cat("\n3. Comparison of Estimates:\n")
cat("OLS coefficient:", round(ols_coeff, 4), "\n")
cat("IV coefficient:", round(iv_coeff, 4), "\n")
cat("Difference:", round(iv_coeff - ols_coeff, 4), "\n")

# 4. Test of endogeneity (Hausman test)
cat("\n4. Hausman Test for Endogeneity:\n")
# Manual Hausman test
residuals_first <- resid(first_stage)
hausman_reg <- lm(y ~ x + controls + residuals_first, data = data)
hausman_pvalue <- summary(hausman_reg)$coefficients["residuals_first", "Pr(>|t|)"]
cat("Hausman test p-value:", round(hausman_pvalue, 4), "\n")
if(hausman_pvalue < 0.05) {
  cat("Reject exogeneity - IV preferred over OLS\n")
} else {
  cat("Cannot reject exogeneity - OLS may be sufficient\n")
}

cat("\n=== FINAL RESULT ===\n")
cat("Causal effect of care intensity on mortality:", round(iv_coeff, 4), "\n")
```

## 3. Expected Findings
I expect a negative coefficient (around -0.5 to -1.0), indicating that higher care intensity reduces mortality rates. The IV estimate should be larger in magnitude than OLS if there's positive selection bias (sicker patients receive more intensive care). The instrument should be strong (F-stat > 10) since distance is a key determinant of healthcare access. This finding would support the hypothesis that healthcare intensity has a protective causal effect on mortality outcomes.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Use distance to nearest hospital as an instrument for care intensity.
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Proximity to a hospital significantly reduces mortality rates.
